description_en: Queries the list of tasks under an Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 调用该接口查询阿里云账号下的任务列表
name: ListJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

INITIALIZING: init.
WAITING: pending scheduling.
IN_PROGRESS: running.
COMPLETED: completed.
CANCELLING: being canceled.
CANCELLED: canceled.
REMOVING: being deleted.
TIMED_OUT: timed out
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值范围：

INITIALIZING：初始化。
WAITING：待调度。
IN_PROGRESS：执行中。
COMPLETED：已完成。
CANCELLING：取消中。
CANCELLED：已取消。
REMOVING：删除中。
TIMED_OUT：已超时
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of tasks to display per page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页展示的任务个数。最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

data.description_en: The task details returned if the invocation is successful. See the following parameter descriptions for details
data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的任务详情信息，请参见以下参数说明

JobId.description_en: The task ID. The globally unique identifier of the task
JobId.description_zh: 任务ID。任务的全局唯一标识符

ScheduledTime.description_en: The scheduled time of the task, in milliseconds
ScheduledTime.description_zh: 任务调度时间的毫秒数

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the task was created

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the task information was last modified

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

PageSize.description_en: The number of tasks on the current page

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

Total.description_en: The total number of tasks returned
